source: Q3 2024 MD&A (Sep 30, 2024); FY2024 company totals from Jan 2025 sales & revenue release
data_status: FY2024 (latest available); company acquired by Royal Gold Oct 20, 2025 — no FY2025

interests.notes: Silver stream: 1.66% of all Ag production, ongoing 2.5% of spot; plus NPI = 1/3 of Horizon Copper's 1.66% Antamina NPI (net of stream delivery cost). Paid by Horizon Copper; mine operated by Cia. Minera Antamina (BHP 33.75%, Glencore 33.75%, Teck 22.5%, Mitsubishi 10%). Carrying amount $180.7M at Sep 30, 2024. Largest carrying-value asset.

Royalty package on Vale assets (15,097 km2): 0.03% NSR on Sossego Cu-Au; 0.06% NSR on Cu+Au and 0.03% on other minerals from certain assets; 0.05% NSR on iron ore Northern System + portion of Southeastern System (SE starts after 1.7 Bt cumulative sales; ~1.66 Bt at Jun 30, 2024); 0.03% of net sales on underlying asset sales. Operator: Vale. Carrying $109.6M at Sep 30, 2024.

Gold stream: 2.375% of Au produced until 120,333 oz delivered, then 1.583%; ongoing 20% of spot + $30/oz for env/social programs. Operator: Equinox Gold (100% since May 2024 Orion buyout). First gold May 2024; commercial production Nov 6, 2024. Carrying $106.3M at Sep 30, 2024.

Gold stream: 10% of Au to 16,000 oz/yr then 5% for rest of year until 300,000 oz delivered; then 0.5% of first 100,000 oz/yr until 10.32 Moz cumulative produced; $572/oz ongoing. Operator: Aurous Resources (Blyvoor Gold). Carrying $103.4M at Sep 30, 2024.
Copper stream: 4.2% of Cu to 39 Mlb delivered (current), then 3.0% to 50 Mlb, then 1.5% LOM; ongoing 30% of spot Cu. Operator: Lundin Mining. Carrying $41.5M at Sep 30, 2024.
Silver stream: 20% of Ag produced (current entitlement); ongoing per-ounce cash payments per stream agreement. Operator: Pan American Silver. Carrying $9.7M at Sep 30, 2024.
Royalty: 2% NSR on Kari North/South tenements (~500 km2). Operator: Endeavour Mining. Carrying $25.8M at Sep 30, 2024.

Royalty: 3-5% sliding NSR (3% at Au <=$1,500/oz; 4% $1,500-2,000; 5% >$2,000) + 2% NSR on greenfields ground (Equinox may buy back half pre-production for $10M). Operator: Equinox Gold. Carrying $7.2M at Sep 30, 2024.
Royalty: 0.63% NSR at Cu >$1.25/lb. Operator: Lundin Mining (with JX Nippon). Carrying $72.2M at Sep 30, 2024.
Royalty: 0.9% NSR on precious metals. Operator: Lundin Gold. Carrying $23.8M at Sep 30, 2024.

Restructured Jan 2024 (Bear Creek): gold stream 275 oz/month to Apr 2028 then 4.4% at 25% of spot; silver stream 100% from May 2028 at 25% of spot; + 1.0% NSR on Corani (Peru) + 28.8M Bear Creek shares + refinanced debentures. Carrying $29.4M at Sep 30, 2024.

Gold stream: 6% to 39,000 oz, then 3.5% to 61,750 oz, then 2%; $400/oz ongoing; Aug 2024 amendment: minimum 4,000-6,000 oz/yr (2024-26), 2,000-3,000 oz/yr (2027-29). Operator: Allied Gold. Carrying $23.9M at Sep 30, 2024.

Zinc stream: 1.0% of zinc processed at CEZinc smelter until later of Jun 30, 2030 or 68 Mlb delivered; ongoing 20% of avg quarterly spot Zn. Operator: Glencore Canada (GCC). Carrying included in 'Other'.

Precious metal stream: 44,712 oz Au fixed deliveries over 7.25 yrs from Q2 2020; after 32,022 oz, 4% of Au+Ag at 30-65% of spot; + 1.4-2.8% NSR on surrounding area. Operator: Americas Gold and Silver. Mining suspended; leaching discontinued Q4 2023. Carrying $24.0M at Sep 30, 2024.

Royalties: 1% NSR producing mine; 2% NSR on oxides (excl. first 396k oz non-deep carbonates); 1.5% NSR on deep carbonates + $30M milestone on commercial production. Operator: Eris LLC. Carrying in 'Other'.
Gold stream: fixed 1,320 oz/yr (2,772 oz/yr final 3.5 yrs), then variable LOM; 20% of spot Au; + 0.21% NSR on prospecting licenses. Operator: Vatukoula Gold Mines. Carrying in 'Other'.
Gold stream: 8% LOM (Black Fox + Froome mines) and 6.3% (Black Fox Extension); ongoing lesser of $601/oz or spot. Operator: McEwen Mining. Carrying in 'Other'.

Gold stream (payable by Horizon Copper): 20% of Au to 405,000 oz at 50% of spot, then 12% LOM at 60% of spot; + 2% NSR. Operator: SSR Mining (40% earn-in) / Lidya / Horizon Copper. FS: 2.45 Moz Au P&P over 13 yrs. Early works ongoing; SSR withdrew guidance Feb 2024 (~1-yr delay). Carrying $207.0M at Sep 30, 2024 (largest asset).

Gold stream: 37.5% of payable Au to 131,250 oz, 30% to 256,980 oz, 1.875% thereafter (80% payability); $100/oz to 256,980 oz then 80% of spot. Operator: Ivanhoe Mines. Phase 1 concentrator complete (care & maintenance to H2 2025); Phase 2 expansion accelerated. Carrying $187.0M at Sep 30, 2024.
Royalty: 2% NSR. Operator: Falco Resources. Apr 2021 FS: ~320k GEO/yr over 15 yrs; 80.9 Mt P&P at 1.44 g/t Au, 14.14 g/t Ag, 0.17% Cu, 0.77% Zn. Carrying $78.9M at Sep 30, 2024.

Precious metals stream via Entrée Resources: 5.62% Au, 4.26% Ag (lesser of $220/oz Au, $5/oz Ag or spot) + 0.42% Cu stream ($0.50/lb or spot). Part of Oyu Tolgoi complex (Rio Tinto operator). Carrying $35.4M at Sep 30, 2024.
Royalty: 0.25% NSR + gold stream conversion option (up to $225M advance -> 20% LOM Au at 30% of spot; exercisable on Glencore board-approved construction). Operator: Glencore. Carrying in 'Other'.
Royalty: sliding 1.0-2.25% NSR (2.25% at Q3 2024 Au prices); Cortez Complex, Nevada. Operators: Barrick (61.5%) / Newmont (38.5%). First production expected 2027. Carrying in 'Other'.
Royalty: 1.05% NSR, $40M cap. Operator: Kinross. FS: 6.7 Moz P&P; 4.7 Moz LOM over 16 yrs. Carrying in 'Other'.
Royalty: 1.0% NSR (Bear Creek's Corani silver project); received Jan 2024 as part of Mercedes restructuring.

~200 additional streams/royalties (portfolio total 231 at Sep 30, 2024; 41 producing mines). Includes retained 2.5-5.0% NSR on Copper Mountain (next $10M of proceeds retained after Evolve sale), royalties sold to Evolve May 2024 (8 non-core, $21M; Highland Valley NPI disposed Jun 2024). Carrying $238.2M at Sep 30, 2024.
